title: Pared her nails too, Thursday for wealth
html_source:
“Trim your nails on —
Monday for news,
Tuesday for shoes,
Wednesday for health,
Thursday for wealth,
Friday for woe,
Saturday, a journey to go.”

~Journal of American Folklore (1918)
